C-SAVE-CLOSE-DATA-SAFETY.Name: Preserve document text across Save All, close and quit
C-SAVE-CLOSE-DATA-SAFETY.Summary: Repair the save/close lifecycle as one bounded stabilization item: Save All must save its intended documents, destructive transitions must depend on confirmed current document state, untitled documents must have a real save route, and active IME composition must remain intact. This draft is for owner review; it authorizes no implementation.

Problem.Baseline: Source baseline: 2a67b1be3b4924e90a323ab9130395f07ea0fcda. ASK_FOR_SAVE_ALL emits mt::save-tabs without a registered backend command. The legacy batch-save endpoint skips untitled entries, broadcasts saved/close by tab id without a revision, and the bootstrap listeners apply those events unconditionally. Several close/quit routes capture Markdown before the confirmation dialog and can discard later edits. The quit/window prompts offer a destructive default for untitled-only sessions. A clean-looking active IME composition can be closed before its preedit enters stored Markdown.
Problem.Evidence: src/renderer/src/store/editor.js: ASK_FOR_SAVE_ALL, CLOSE_UNSAVED_TAB, QUIT_APP, LISTEN_FOR_CLOSE, APPLY_TAB_SAVED; src/renderer/src/bootstrap-ipc.js: mt::tab-saved and mt::force-close-tabs-by-id listeners; src-tauri/src/m001_save_close.rs: save_and_close_inner and mt_save_and_close_tabs. Existing reproductions: tests/e2e/perf/characterization-save-close.spec.ts and tests/e2e/perf/characterization-ime-seeded.spec.ts. The archived C-LARGE-DOC-STAGE-0 R-7 records these as defects, not accepted behavior.

Goals.R-001: Cover Save All, single-tab close, Close All/Other Tabs, the main document-window close control and File/Quit or its keyboard/palette entry. A workspace replacement that invokes this save/close pipeline must wait for the same safe result before clearing the old document set. Settings-window closure and new multi-window behavior are outside this item.
Goals.R-002: Before deciding that a document is clean, saving or discarding it, obtain its fresh committed text from its actual owned editing surface/model. After a save confirmation or Save As picker, revalidate ownership and obtain the payload then, rather than using text captured before the interaction. Preserve complete-model serialization during progressive mounting and pending rich/source updates. Bind the attempt to document lifetime, content revision and destination ownership; an active-tab switch must not retarget it.
Goals.R-003: Save All considers the intended open editable documents, writes every text-dirty named document and offers Save As for dirty untitled documents in stable tab order. Empty or whitespace-only dirty text must not be skipped. Clean documents and untouched empty drafts require no redundant write or picker. Save All never closes documents. Each successful result is applied only to its matching document/revision; all-saved success is reported only when every requested save succeeds and no newer target edit remains.
Goals.R-004: Save As cancellation or a write failure stops further batch work and all pending close/quit/workspace-replacement transitions. Earlier completed writes remain real and may be reflected as saved; they are not rolled back. All original target tabs remain open on a failed or cancelled batch. Untitled content is never silently skipped or treated as implicit discard. A destination already owned by another open tab must fail safely within these flows, preserving both tabs and buffers; it must not silently evict that tab.
Goals.R-005: Owner decision: if newer text appears after a save payload was dispatched, the acknowledged older version must not mark the newer version clean or authorize closure. Keep the document open with its newer buffer and unsaved indicator. Do not automatically save again or close when a later debounce fires. Retrying is a new explicit owner action with a fresh payload. The same freshness check applies after a discard decision if newer edits appear before the destructive transition.
Goals.R-006: A batch close/quit has a final close barrier: close no target tab until all required writes and freshness checks succeed. Before destroying the main window or exiting, recheck the entire live document set, including new dirty documents created during the attempt. Scope Close All/Other Tabs to the intended identities; later unrelated tabs must not be closed accidentally. An invalidated attempt keeps its documents/window open and never continues into quit or workspace replacement.
Goals.R-007: Active IME composition is unsaved input even when stored Markdown and isSaved still look clean. In either rich or source/split editing, refuse the save/close attempt before a destructive re-render, confirmation dialog, payload extraction or closure while any target has active composition. Leave the preedit, focus and document intact; show a nonmodal explanation to finish input and retry. Do not synthesize compositionend, silently cancel preedit or queue an automatic destructive continuation. After actual compositionend, a fresh explicit attempt captures the completed text exactly once.
Goals.R-008: A bare saved/close-by-id broadcast or an acknowledgement belonging to a cancelled, superseded, closed/reopened or path-invalidated document must not mark live content saved, close a tab or exit the app. The authoritative result must be matched to the actual write attempt and current owner/revision. Guard existing single-save/autosave completions where they participate in the close decision. Preserve ordinary save outcomes, saved-history ownership and background-tab targeting.
Goals.R-009: Coordinate re-entrant save/close/quit requests so repeated input does not create concurrent dialogs, duplicate writes or multiple exits. A close success cannot be authorized while a known older write can still invalidate its saved-text proof; wait for a safe boundary or refuse the attempt with feedback. Cancelled operations may receive late write results, but those results never resume an abandoned close. This is the lifecycle barrier for this item; the general physical-write scheduler remains a separate change.
Goals.R-010: Use the existing notification system for a stale-save refusal, preserving editor focus and the unsaved indicator. Explain that new edits arrived during saving, remain unsaved, and the document was kept open. Identify the affected document or summarize affected targets for a batch; explain that window close/quit was stopped where applicable. Offer an explicit retry action bound to the original safe target identities and fresh current content. For a single close its meaning is Save again and close. A stale retry action cannot act on a different/reopened tab. Coalesce duplicate notifications per attempt; do not show a blocking error modal for normal concurrent typing. New copy and actions use the shipped localization system.
Goals.R-011: Every destructive confirmation has three distinct meanings: save then close/quit, explicit discard, and cancel. Save is the default; Escape and the close glyph mean cancel. Saving untitled documents opens Save As. No save-labelled action may discard an unnamed or failed target. A write failure remains visible and cannot yield a saved/closed success. Save All has no discard fallback. Explicitly discarding the confirmed text is still supported.
Goals.R-012: Preserve the accepted table/viewer/Find interactions, split shared history, exact committed Markdown, navigation-only clean state, saved-tab recovery and reading-position/session behavior. Retain sandbox/path validation, desktop/App Store capability boundaries, existing performance and coverage floors, and unchanged release authorization rules. Do not freeze normal typing during disk I/O to avoid the race.

Constraints.Constraint: The owner requested sequential items with pauses and specs. This stage produces only this draft spec and a readable review copy. A plan follows explicit spec approval; implementation follows plan approval. Pause again after the tested artifact/acceptance before item two.

Match the existing shared save and composition boundaries before introducing helpers. Keep the Muya engine and established dialog/notification patterns. Plan any IPC-result changes consistently across registration, types, shim and consumers; version assumptions cannot be silently mixed.

Only destructive lifecycle guards around existing rename/path changes or an owned-path Save As collision belong here. The broader rename/move/metadata and filesystem/byte-policy repairs remain later items. If an unresolved dependency prevents a stated safety criterion, expose it at the plan pause rather than weakening the criterion or silently expanding scope.

Historical Stage 0 bundles stay unchanged. Live characterization tests for repaired families must assert the desired safety invariant, while unrelated known-defect evidence remains truthful. No timeout, retry, skip, budget or coverage weakening is allowed.

NonGoals.NonGoal: General rename/Move To repair, metadata-only dirty tracking, external byte-equivalence, encoding/BOM/EOL preservation, global write reordering, atomic replace, crash recovery or WAL. This item must not claim those guarantees.
New export/theme/agent features, a general document-model refactor, new cross-window editing, release version changes, tags, dispatch or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-001: Named, untitled, mixed, empty-dirty and clean targets exercise Save All through a real registered transport; persisted text, saved state and absence of closure match R-003. Cancellation and partial failure satisfy R-004 with no false all-saved result.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-002: Editing while a confirmation/picker is open saves the fresh confirmed text. Editing after payload dispatch preserves the newer buffer, dirty indicator and open tab/window, with the R-010 explanation. Explicit retry saves a fresh payload and closes only when that new attempt is valid.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-003: Both named and untitled close/quit flows expose safe save/discard/cancel behavior. Untitled-only and mixed sessions cannot exit through a save-labelled choice without a real write. Escape, cancelled Save As and write failure preserve open content.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-004: Controlled delayed acknowledgements, tab switches, close/reopen, owned-path collisions, re-entrant requests and known older writes cannot save/close a different or newer document. Batch failure or invalidation causes zero target closures; a newly dirty document prevents window destruction or quit.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-005: Rich/source/split active-composition cases, including the retained clean-looking close-loss seed, preserve preedit and refuse the attempt with feedback. Completing composition then explicitly retrying saves the final canonical text once. Real OS IME smoke is distinguished from synthesized browser composition evidence.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-006: Focused store/bootstrap/dialog/composition tests, real renderer keyboard/menu flows, backend result/failure tests, full renderer coverage, IPC type checks, build and exact-candidate hosted gates pass. A source-bound isolated native artifact has a short case-per-file acceptance protocol. Current integrity/status are rerun at implementation handoff; known unrelated warnings and defects are reported separately.

AffectedAreas.Paths: src-tauri/src/m001_save_close.rs and lifecycle/registration adapters; src/renderer/src/store/editor.js; bootstrap-ipc.js and IPC result types/shims; editorWithTabs rich/source composition and freshness adapters; existing unsaved-close/notification/localization surfaces; workspace replacement caller guards. Exact writes and verification ownership are fixed in the later approved plan.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red/green reproductions for the owned known-loss families, exact canonical text and final on-disk text where backend evidence applies, revision/lifetime/destination identity traces without document payload logging, negative close/quit assertions, fresh retry checks, and an unchanged accepted-interaction baseline.

The plan selects existing and new focused tests around tests/renderer/bootstrap-ipc.test.ts, store/editor and unsaved-close-dialog fixtures, tests/e2e/unsaved-close-actions.spec.ts, characterization-save-close.spec.ts and the owned IME seeded scenario. Rust save/close and lifecycle tests must include partial failure and invalid result ownership. Native macOS and Windows evidence is recorded separately from the renderer harness.

Assumptions.OwnerDecision: On 2026-11-10 the owner selected keeping the document open when typing overtakes Save and Close, then explicitly requested understandable feedback. R-005 records that choice; R-010 proposes its notification/retry presentation for review.
Assumptions.ProposedDefault: Stop a batch at the first cancellation, failure or unsafe owner/composition state; preserve already completed writes and keep all target tabs open. This is a draft default for approval.

Active IME refuses the attempt with an explanation and requires an explicit retry after input completes. It does not synthesize completion or silently schedule a later close. This is a draft default for approval.
